about.title: About
about.subtitle: My story
about.paragraph1: I'm a Junior Full-Stack developer with a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from UNOPAR and over 1 year of professional experience building real projects with React, Next.js, and Laravel.
about.paragraph2: I work with the JavaScript ecosystem on the frontend and PHP/Laravel on the backend, focusing on clean code, best practices, and delivering value. I have experience with automated testing, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL.
about.paragraph3: Outside of coding, I explore new technologies, read personal development books, and exercise to stay balanced.
